name: Filatex India Ltd
title: Filatex India Ltd-$ - 526227 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 13.9% YoY to INR 86.3 cr on lower volume, but March spread fell to roughly EBITDA-neutral and management sees Q1 FY27 output 20-25% below 1 lakh tons per quarter.

utilisation.quote: the industry is running at around 60% capacity utilization, we are running at around 75%

capex.peers_comment: Reliance PTA 3.2 mn t by end CY2027; IOC Paradip and GAIL Mangalore PTA additions expected to add about 2.4 mn t
capex.quote: Filatex is under a comprehensive CAPEX program of INR 690 crores

triggers.label: March spread near EBITDA-neutral
triggers.quote: If I take March independently I think we would be EBITDA-neutral, there would be hardly any EBITDA in March

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 output 20-25% below run-rate
triggers.quote: It could be lower by anything from 20% to 25% minimum as of now

triggers.label: Customers at zero raw material inventory
triggers.quote: Right now everybody has zero inventory on their raw materials

triggers.label: Some demand recovery from April
triggers.quote: Although now some recovery in demand we can see from starting of this month

triggers.label: Chinese yarn imports rising after QCO revocation
triggers.quote: after the QCO revocation there was a lot of imports from China, so that is why we also had some margin pressure

guidance.quote: it will maybe around INR 4,500 crores in this year and in FY28 it could be around INR 4,800 crores in Filatex
FY27 end we would have a debt of around INR 350 crores to INR 360 crores on the outset
maybe one month more…maybe in mid-July max
That is to start by end of September
steady state we should do something about double digit in Filatex

red_flags.label: Forex loss ~INR 13 cr hit Q4 PAT
red_flags.quote: a foreign exchange fluctuations charge of around INR 13 crores that came in Q4 which has actually dented our bottom line

red_flags.label: Management shifts to YoY comparison to avoid QoQ decline
red_flags.quote: Therefore, for a more meaningful assessment, we are presenting year-on-year comparison Q4 FY26 versus Q4 FY25

red_flags.label: Prices below Chinese landed cost basis
red_flags.quote: your selling prices are 10% lower and that is the reason for the compression in margins today?

evasions.quote: So, let us see how things go forward.
Saving in terms of what? You have to buy PTA.
It is difficult to say how it will shape up in the next couple of months
